text.en: This Order may be cited as the Criminal Conduct (Recovery of Proceeds) (Designated Countries) Order, 2008. -Designated countries.

The countries specified in the first column of the Schedule are designated as countries to whose external confiscation orders and proceedings the Criminal Conduct (Recovery of Proceeds) Order, 2000 (S 52/2000) shall apply. Appropriate authorities.

The appropriate authorities of designated countries that are to give effect to the provisions of the Criminal Conduct (Recovery of Proceeds) Order, 2000 (S 52/2000) in relation to the external confiscation orders and to related proceedings are sp~cified in the second column of the Schedule. SCHEDULE (paragraph 2)

DESIGNATED COUNTRIES AND APPROPRIATE AUTHORITIES Designated country Appropriate authority Kingdom of Cambodia Republic of Indonesia Lao People's Democratic Republic Malaysia Attorney General Union of Myanmar Republic of the Philippines 27th. MAY, 2008 SCHEDULE -Continued Designated country Appropriate authority Republic of Singapore Attorney General Kingdom of Thailand Socialist Republic of Viet Nam Ministry of Public Security. Made this 14th. day of Jamadilawal, 1429 Hijriah corresponding to the 20th. day of May, 2008.

DATO PADUKA AWANG HAJI ALI BIN APONG Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Finance, Brunei Darussalam. l I I I I I
